entry.name: AI for Everyone
entry.note: A non-technical course on what AI can and cannot do inside an organisation
entry.audience: Managers, executives and anyone working alongside technical teams

reading.cost: Free to join; a certificate can be purchased.
covers: Common AI terminology such as neural networks, machine learning, deep learning, and data science
What AI realistically can and cannot do
How to spot opportunities to apply AI to problems in your own organization
What it feels like to build machine learning and data science projects
How to work with an AI team and build an AI strategy in your company
How to navigate ethical and societal discussions surrounding AI
Workflow of a machine learning project
How to choose an AI project
reading.format: Online course with lectures and graded assignments. A certificate is available upon completion.
reading.summary: This course introduces artificial intelligence for a broad audience. It explains common AI terminology, what AI can and cannot do, and how to spot opportunities to apply AI in an organization. It also covers working with an AI team, building an AI strategy, and ethical and societal issues. Completing the course shows an understanding of AI fundamentals and business applications.
reading.audience: The course is for non-technical colleagues and anyone in an organization who wants to use AI better. Engineers can also take it to learn the business aspects of AI.
